digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 21 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, TypeScript, Rust）。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: obra/superpowers
repos.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI 编码 Agent 掌握可复用工程技能与开发方法论，把零散提示变成可靠工作流

repos.name: affaan-m/ECC
repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencod
repos.summary_zh: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码 Agent 提供技能、记忆与安全优化的性能增强框架，让 Agent 更聪明可靠

repos.name: anomalyco/opencode
repos.description: The open source coding agent.
repos.summary_zh: 开源编码智能体，让开发者用自然语言直接驱动代码生成与修改，TypeScript 打造

repos.name: microsoft/markitdown
repos.description: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
repos.summary_zh: 微软开源的文件转 Markdown 工具，把 Office、PDF 等资料转成 RAG 可读格式

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
repos.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
repos.summary_zh: 浏览器里的间谍卫星模拟器，用真实开源数据在逼真3D地球上做实时空间情报分析

repos.name: jiji262/douyin-downloader
repos.description: A practical Douyin downloader for both single-item and profile batch downloads, with progress display, retries, SQLite deduplication, and browser fall
repos.summary_zh: 抖音批量下载神器，支持视频图集合集音乐去水印，SQLite去重加浏览器兜底

repos.name: bikini/exploitarium
repos.description: A single archive of public exploit PoCs and vulnerability research writeups. At the time I post these, none have been reported. Feel free to report th
repos.summary_zh: 汇集未公开的漏洞 PoC 与漏洞研究笔记，抢先自报 CVE 拿署名

repos.name: jordan-gibbs/hyperresearch
repos.description: Agent-driven research knowledge base. Agents collect, search, and synthesize web research into a persistent, searchable wiki.
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI Agent 自动搜集、检索并整合网络研究，沉淀为持久可搜索的 Wiki 知识库

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: datawhalechina/zero-to-sglang
repos.description: Official SGLang × Datawhale course on LLM inference (中英双语): understand inference, build a mini-sglang from scratch, then read the real SGLang source a
repos.summary_zh: Datawhale 出品的 SGLang 双语实战课，带你手搓 mini-sglang 读懂 LLM 推理并冲刺首个 PR

repos.name: XHToken/Spark-X2.5
repos.description: Spark-x2.5 open model series. Pushing the Limits of Agentic Capabilities in On-Device Models
repos.summary_zh: 端侧模型也能跑出智能体级能力，Spark-X2.5 把 Agent 上限推到设备本地

repos.name: Thinking-Space/One-Shot-OPD
repos.description: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models II: One Training Example
repos.summary_zh: 仅需一个训练样本即可完成大模型在线策略蒸馏，大幅降低蒸馏数据成本

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: hewanglanhao/deepvision-studio
repos.description: Interactive deep learning lab for visualizing forward/backpropagation, training real PyTorch models, and exploring CNNs, Transformers, RNNs, and AI hi
repos.summary_zh: 交互式深度学习实验室，可视化前向与反向传播并训练真实 PyTorch 模型，直观探索 CNN、Transformer 与 RNN

repos.name: tosinonye7-ui/SummaraMind-Transformer-Suite
repos.description: Advanced Transformer Summarization Suite: Abstract & Extractive AI Models 2026
repos.summary_zh: 整合BART与KMeans聚类，一站式搞定抽象与抽取式摘要的Transformer工具套件

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev
repos.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Tauri 的跨平台现代代理客户端，为 Clash 用户提供轻量高效的图形界面体验

repos.name: lencx/ChatGPT
repos.description: ❄️ ChatGPT Desktop Application (Mac, Windows and Linux)
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Rust 打造的跨平台 ChatGPT 桌面客户端，让 Mac、Windows 和 Linux 用户都能一键快捷调用 AI 对话

repos.name: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
repos.description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
repos.summary_zh: 从零手写实现 AI 核心组件的 Python 实战教程，边学边造轮子真正吃透大模型原理

repos.name: eythaann/Seelen-UI
repos.description: The Fully Customizable Desktop Environment for Windows 10/11.
repos.summary_zh: 为 Windows 10/11 打造的全可定制桌面环境，用 Rust 重写系统外壳，让桌面布局与交互随心所欲

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: microsoft/vscode
repos.description: Visual Studio Code
repos.summary_zh: 微软出品的免费跨平台代码编辑器，凭轻量极速与海量插件生态成为全球开发者首选工具

repos.name: OpenHands/OpenHands
repos.description: 🙌 OpenHands: AI-Driven Development
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI 像开发者一样自主写代码改 Bug 的开源编程智能体，支持全流程自动化开发

repos.name: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
repos.description: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
repos.summary_zh: 为 AI 编码工具提供 38 种编辑级图表模板，纯 HTML+SVG 自包含渲染，告别 Mermaid 的粗糙质感

repos.name: AlexsJones/llmfit
repos.description: Hundreds of models & providers. One command to find what runs on your hardware.
repos.summary_zh: 一条命令从数百模型与供应商中筛出能在你硬件上跑的，Rust 打造免去手动查配置的烦恼
